question: Q3: degrees of freedom or score-optimal value of m8.
number: Degrees of freedom of m8: 32 bits (all used: the chain domain is 2^256). The circuit cost does not depend on the value while it is variable. If the word were frozen, the score-optimal constant is 0: ops with 0 -> 577, 1 -> 579, 0x9e3779b9 -> 579, 0xffffffff -> 580 (baseline 595). Which digest word feeds m8 is free (relabelling registers costs no op; the tracer does not depend on the naming).
notes: Tools first reproduced: 7-round empty-input vector af1349b9...f3262 and verifier blake3.py (rounds 1,2,3,5,7 on 40 random blocks each, 3-round 0^32||x on 100 inputs, all equal); traced circuit = 595 ops and time_log2 125.10856 (shipped), 0 mismatches vs scalar on 200 inputs. Value dependence tested only on the constants named; cost depends on constant folding of zero and on whether an all-constant G call appears.
held_fixed: other words as in the target; counts from our tracer
reopen_if: the embedding of the digest into x gets a non-identity map that costs ops, or a nonzero constant helps through a carry-structure trick
